sentences.text: This is the first application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.50/2025 registered at Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Section 111, 111(2)(a), 111(2)(b), 111(3), 111(4) & 222(a) of B.N.S..

entities.text: Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 07.02.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the applicant and co-accused persons have involved in the business of prostitution.
They have indulged the prosecutrix into the said business.
Thereafter, they have solemnized the marriage of prosecutrix with one person on the basis of forged Aadhar Card.
Therefore, the offence has been registered against the present applicant and co-accused persons under the aforesaid section.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is in custody since 07.02.2025.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42642 2 MCRC-25590-2025
It is submitted that the applicant is waiter in Hotel K Square situated at Shahpura, Bhopal in which one sex worker was murdered.
The Crime No.146/2024 was registered in P.S. Shahpura, Bhopal against Ashutosh Bajpayee and other persons.
In that crime, the applicant was also named but he has been released on bail by Trial Court by order dated 10.05.2024.

It is further submitted that only due to this reason,
the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
The statement of prosecutrix has been recorded in the Trial Court in which she has not taken name of present applicant regarding alleged offence.
In the statements under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. also, name of present applicant is not mentioned.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.

In these circumstances, applicant Surendra Alias Sagar Chouhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61667728/
1 may be granted bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that there is named FIR against present applicant.
One mobile has also been seized from present applicant.
One mobile has also been seized from present applicant in which photographs of customers and several girls were found.
The applicant is actively involved in these type of offences.
The material witnesses are yet to be examined before Trial Court.

The applicant has also criminal antecedents of one case registered at Crime No.146/2024 in P.S. Shahpura, District Bhopal under Sections 302, 376, 377, 201 of IPC and Section 3,4,5 & 7 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956.
Hence, the applicant does not deserve grant of bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as act of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:42642 3 MCRC-25590-2025 present applicant and seriousness of the offence, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE mohsin Surendra Alias Sagar Chouhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61667728/
